move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You get straight to the offer and then back to the machines—it sounds like you value keeping the commercial discussion practical and brief. We want a competitive agreement that is straightforward for you to deliver. What flexibility in payment or delivery would help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. 

Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. If you pay in 14 days, I can beat that and do 15.80 with DAP and 42 days lead time. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
